summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into the OS temp directory, extracts and chmods the Bun binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation (constant array `n7gIxM=[...]` with a `WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9` decoder and `_0x...` identifier naming). The package's advertised purpose is a React marketing-integration widget library, and its `main` (`dist/index.js`) consists of trivial re-exports that never reference `math_init.js`; the obfuscated bundle is reachable only via the preinstall-launched Bun runtime. Downloading a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated payload on every installer's machine at `npm install` time gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on installer hosts under the user's privileges, disjoint from anything the package claims to provide.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
